nodeOrderNote: Every node in every template is required and non-repeatable: the clone has exactly one real composition per page shape and no evidence of optional sections. A PageSpec must reproduce the node list in order, keyed on (section, variant).

deadSlugPolicy.statement: Dead sitemap slugs map to 'not-found' and may never be bound to a landing/home/pricing template (enforced: graph rule ROUTE_TEMPLATE_BINDING).

evidence.anchor: do not create 8 separate landing pages
No shared "landing hero template" is needed

excludedRoutes.statement: Snapshot scope = home, pricing, not-found. These routes exist on the live site (or are linked from built pages) but are NOT modelled in this snapshot, so no template is invented for them and a PageSpec targeting one is rejected. NOTE: while this snapshot was being built, a concurrent build agent landed blog/text/legal pages in src/ (src/pages/routes.jsx). They stay excluded here until a design-repo rebuild models them; verify_all.py WARNs (does not fail) for every source route that is built but excluded.

unmodelledGlobalOverlays.note: Landed concurrently with the blog build: App.jsx now renders a fixed cookie-consent bar on EVERY route (incl. home/pricing/404). It is an out-of-flow overlay, not a section node, and is not modelled in this snapshot.

contentPolicy.longFormText: Blog article bodies and legal/text-page copy are intentionally PLACEHOLDER in the clone (long-form text is not copied). Never treat any long-form body as real Riley copy.
contentPolicy.realStatements: Testimonial quotes/attributions, clinician names/credentials, plan prices/features, press logos and competitor comparison marks are real-world claims: reuse verbatim only in brandContext 'riley-clone'; never fabricate them for any brand.
contentPolicy.shortUiCopy: Short UI copy in schema/example.pagespec.json is taken verbatim from the built components.
